description: This is a Java test class for RawMessageMapper, testing its functionality in mapping messages to external representations and vice versa within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: RawMessageMapperTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for RawMessageMapper, testing various mapping scenarios between internal messages and external messages within Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the RawMessageMapper instance before each test.

methods.name: mapFromMessageWithoutPayloadWithoutContentType
methods.description: Tests mapping from a message with no payload and no content type.

methods.name: mapFromMessageWithTextPayload
methods.description: Tests mapping from a message with a text payload.

methods.name: mapFromMessageWithBinaryPayload
methods.description: Tests mapping from a message with a binary payload.

methods.name: mapFromJsonMessageWithBinaryContentType
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when mapping a JSON message with a binary content type.

methods.name: mapFromTextMessageWithBinaryContentType
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when mapping a text message with a binary content type.

methods.name: mapFromNonMessageCommand
methods.description: Tests mapping a non-message command, expecting to delegate to the default message mapper.

methods.name: mapFromMessageWithDittoProtocolContentType
methods.description: Tests mapping a message with a Ditto protocol-specific content type, expecting default mapping.

methods.name: mapToMessageWithoutHeadersOrConfig
methods.description: Tests exception when mapping an external message without headers or config.

methods.name: mapToMessageWithoutThingId
methods.description: Tests exception when mapping an external message missing the thing ID.

methods.name: mapToBinaryMessagePerDefault
methods.description: Tests mapping to a binary message with default configuration.

methods.name: mapToTextMessage
methods.description: Tests mapping to a text message with appropriate headers.

methods.name: mapToTextMessageWithContentTypeOverride
methods.description: Tests overriding content type via headers when mapping to a text message.

methods.name: mapToBinaryMessageWithContentTypeOverride
methods.description: Tests overriding content type to binary via headers when mapping.

methods.name: mapToJsonMessage
methods.description: Tests mapping from headers and payload to a JSON message.

methods.name: mapToDittoProtocolMessage
methods.description: Tests mapping a message that is handled as a Ditto protocol message.

methods.name: mapToSendFeatureMessageResponse
methods.description: Tests mapping to a response message for a feature send command.

methods.name: mapToNonMessageCommandWithDittoProtocolContentType
methods.description: Tests mapping a non-message command with a Ditto protocol content type, expecting default mapping.
